findings.title: Job is suspended
findings.cause: Job train has waited 12m0s, suspended, for Kueue to admit it from LocalQueue team-a, and this cluster does not serve Kueue's API (kueue.x-k8s.io): Kueue is not installed, so nothing will ever unsuspend the Job

evidence.command: kubectl get job train -n kd-kueue-not-installed -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend}{" "}{.status.conditions}'

evidence.what: the cluster has no resource type localqueues.kueue.x-k8s.io

findings.fix: Install Kueue and create LocalQueue team-a, or, to run the Job without it, recreate it without the kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name label and with suspend: false.
